WITH monthly_txn AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        strftime('%Y-%m', CAST(txn_date AS DATE)) as month,
        txn_date,
        CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
             WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
             ELSE 0 END as balance_change
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_month_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        SUM(balance_change) as month_balance
    FROM monthly_txn
    GROUP BY customer_id, month
),
cumulative AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month,
        month_balance,
        SUM(month_balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month
                                ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) as end_of_month_balance
    FROM customer_month_balance
),
total_by_month AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        SUM(end_of_month_balance) as total_balance
    FROM cumulative
    GROUP BY month
),
with_next AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        total_balance,
        LEAD(month) OVER (ORDER BY month) as next_month
    FROM total_by_month
),
final_output AS (
    SELECT 
        next_month as output_month,
        CASE WHEN total_balance < 0 THEN 0 ELSE total_balance END as total_balance
    FROM with_next
    WHERE next_month IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT * FROM final_output ORDER BY output_month
